title: Threadline Explorer & Correlation Ribbon — Request Forensics Composer
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, scannable explorer for deep request forensics that combines a linear "threadline" view of interleaved spans with a correlation ribbon highlighting related requests across services and time. The goal is to let engineers pivot from a single request to its causal surface area (siblings, retries, background tasks) without losing the original timeline context. Focus areas: compact span summarization, multi-select filters (correlation IDs / tags / latency buckets), inline quick-actions (open logs, jump-to-trace, blame), and a responsive prototype for wide and narrow consoles.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates threadline view with collapsible span groups and per-span metadata overlays (duration, resource, status)
Correlation ribbon surfaces related request groups, allows hover previews and one-click expansion into the main threadline
Filter composer supports building queries by correlation ID, service name, tag sets, and duration ranges; filters persist across navigation in the console
Accessible keyboard navigation and focus states for span selection, ribbon items, and filter chips
Design tokens and components mapped to existing Console UI library; handoff spec includes responsive breakpoints and spacing rules

2026-02-28 - User testing (3 backend engineers): Users appreciated the ribbon hover preview; asked for a fast 'collapse to root' shortcut and clearer indication when spans are sampled vs complete. Adding a sampled badge and approximate counts.

2026-03-01 - Aisha Patel: Updated prototype to include sampled-state badge, 'collapse-to-root' keyboard shortcut, and refined spacing. Logging the remaining follow-ups as checklist items for handoff. Moving ticket to In Review for PM and Eng sign-off.
design_decisions: Use a two-stream fetch model: lightweight summary tiles + lazy-loaded expanded span details
Correlation ribbon uses deterministic hashing + time-window clustering to present related groups with stable colors
Filters persist in URL; use query param schema 'threadline.q=<encoded>' for shareability
Dense mode reduces tile padding and hides less-critical metadata, but preserves quick-actions
